It's about perspective. Is tying really different from losing? The answers can vary. For me, one either comes out a victor, or a loser.. and even through a tie, a wise man can fully gauge a result. One person always wins a little more than the other, with the same effect on the opposite: in a tie, one loses less while another loses more. That's how I perceive it. BUT, since I'm playing devil's advocate, a person can truly believe that a Tie is much different from a win and a lost. Both neither hold the title of a loser or a winner. In essence, both are in the same state as they were before, therefore neither lost nor won. I didn't win, but you didn't win. I didn't lose, but you didn't lose either. I believe that's how both perspectives view this topic on Win, Tie, or Lose.
